title: Shared Dialog, Filter Tabs, Pagination — ConfirmActionDialog, AdminFilterTabs, AdminPagination
content:
Create or refactor three shared admin components from existing patterns.

## ConfirmActionDialog — generic confirm dialog
Extracted from inline delete dialog in courses/page.tsx, and used as base for RejectDialog.
- Dialog wrapper (shadcn Dialog) with title, description, confirm/cancel buttons
- Shows loading state on confirm button
- Props: { open, onOpenChange, title, description, onConfirm, confirmLabel?, cancelLabel?, loading? }
- RejectDialog refactored to extend this base

## AdminFilterTabs — generalized from EnrolmentFilters
- EnrolmentFilters.tsx is hardcoded to payment statuses (ALL/Pending/Verified/Rejected)
- Generalize to accept array of { label, value, count? }
- Props: { tabs: { label, value, count? }[], selected, onChange }
- Rename file from EnrolmentFilters.tsx to AdminFilterTabs.tsx

## AdminPagination — renamed from EnrolmentPagination
- EnrolmentPagination is already nearly generic
- Rename to AdminPagination, update all imports
- Props unchanged: { page, totalPages, onPageChange }

Pure refactoring — no behavior change.

evidence.residual: Existing pages (enrolments) still reference EnrolmentFilters and EnrolmentPagination — will be updated in AD-007-3.

acceptance: ConfirmActionDialog renders with title, description, confirm/cancel buttons
ConfirmActionDialog shows loading spinner on confirm button when loading=true
AdminFilterTabs accepts configurable tab definitions (label, value, count)
AdminFilterTabs highlights selected tab and calls onChange
AdminPagination renders prev/next buttons with page info, triggers onPageChange
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
dependencies: AD-007 is the parent. AD-007-1 provides AdminDataTable pattern conventions.
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && verify each component renders correctly in isolation.
